test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
In question, a few statements have been given followed by some conclusions. Consider the statements to be true and answer which of the given conclusions are correct with respectively.

**Statements:**

All songs are poems.

All poems are rhymes.

No rhyme is a paragraph.

**Conclusions:**

I. No song is a paragraph.

II. No poem is a paragraph.

options.text: either conclusion I or conclusion II follows
both conclusion I and conclusion II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21051d03743031528b0429c710f637dcb2123a85f0d5679b3f0f4d061b45242d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No song is a paragraph → Follow (As all songs are poems, all poems are rhymes and no rhyme is a paragraph. As whole songs comes in poems which whole comes in rhymes which cannot be paragraph, therefore it is true)

II. No poem is a paragraph → Follow (As all poems are rhymes and no rhyme is a paragraph. As whole poems comes in rhymes which cannot be paragraph, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, both conclusion I and conclusion II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
